arch_opening: There is an update available — version 1.8.0. The theme is 'the log must not grow forever': token-usage fixes measured on a real project. BUILD-LOG now rotates completed history into an archive instead of growing unbounded, and the version-check instructions moved out of the role file into a playbook loaded only when an update actually exists. This update changes your Architect role file's Session Start — I'll walk you through exactly what applies.

changes.title: Version check moved to playbooks/VERSION-CHECK.md
changes.what_changed: The Architect role file's Session Start step 2 shrank from a ~450-word procedure to three lines: read version_notified, fetch latest.json, skip silently on match or network failure — otherwise load the new playbooks/VERSION-CHECK.md, which now holds the full update walk-through (version groups, critical-first ordering, arch_opening, how_to_assess, recording version_notified).
changes.old_behavior: The full walk-through procedure sat inline in the role file and was parsed on every single session start, even though it applies only on the rare session where an update exists.
changes.new_behavior: Session start carries only the cheap pre-check (~500 tokens saved per session); the expensive instructions load on demand, exactly when an update is found.
changes.user_impact_plain: Every Architect session starts ~500 tokens lighter with identical behavior — the walk-through still runs, just only when there is something to walk through.
changes.user_impact_critical: If the Architect role file is updated without installing playbooks/VERSION-CHECK.md, the next version check will reference a file that does not exist and the update walk breaks. The two changes must land together — that is why this version is a mandatory checkpoint.
changes.how_to_assess: Check whether playbooks/VERSION-CHECK.md exists in the project. If not: run the clone's ./upgrade tool (it refreshes playbooks/ additively) or copy templates/project-folder/playbooks/VERSION-CHECK.md from the clone. Then update the user's Architect role file Session Start step 2 to the three-line form the v1.8.0 template carries — preserving their team names and personas. Never update the role file without installing the playbook first.
changes.user_decision: Want me to install playbooks/VERSION-CHECK.md and compress the version-check step in your Architect file? Behavior is identical — it just stops paying for the instructions on sessions that don't need them.

changes.title: BUILD-LOG rotation — completed history moves to an archive
changes.what_changed: A new Anti-Drift rule in the Architect role file (and the Codex skill): when a step clears, or BUILD-LOG passes ~300 lines, completed-step details, closed Known Gaps, and full Lesson text move to handoff/archive/BUILD-LOG-<YYYY-MM>.md. BUILD-LOG keeps Current Status, the active step, open gaps, one-line lessons, and one-line pointers to archived steps.
changes.old_behavior: BUILD-LOG grew unbounded — 'update immediately' plus 'never delete' meant every full read cost more each step. A real project hit 38KB (~10K tokens per read) in four steps.
changes.new_behavior: BUILD-LOG stays lean and cheap to read; nothing is lost — full history lives in the archive file, read only when investigating how a past step was built.
changes.user_impact_plain: Sessions that fall back to reading BUILD-LOG (stale or missing checkpoint) cost a fraction of what they did, and the saving grows with project age instead of shrinking.
changes.how_to_assess: Check the size of handoff/BUILD-LOG.md. Over ~300 lines: offer to perform the first rotation now — create handoff/archive/BUILD-LOG-<YYYY-MM>.md, move completed steps, closed Known Gaps, and full Lesson text there, leave one-line pointers. Then add the rotation rule to the user's Architect role file Anti-Drift section, preserving their team names.
changes.user_decision: Want me to rotate your BUILD-LOG into an archive now and add the rotation rule so it stays lean? Nothing is deleted — completed history moves to handoff/archive/.

changes.title: Stale _temp/ARCHITECT.md removed from the project-folder template
changes.what_changed: templates/project-folder/_temp/ARCHITECT.md — an unreferenced leftover copy of an old Architect role file — is deleted from the template set. No script or document referenced it.
changes.old_behavior: Projects installed from the project-folder template carried a stale ~6KB duplicate role file in _temp/, an accidental-read hazard for any session grepping for role definitions.
changes.user_impact_plain: One less stale file that could be read by mistake and silently contradict the real role file.
changes.how_to_assess: Check whether _temp/ARCHITECT.md exists in the project and whether manifest.md references it (it never should). If present and unreferenced, offer to delete the _temp directory.
changes.user_decision: You have a stale _temp/ARCHITECT.md from the old template — delete it?
